# Vendored files

Bundled so the app works offline. Do not edit them.

- `tone/Tone.js`: Tone.js 14.8.49, `build/Tone.js` from the npm package `tone@14.8.49`, unmodified. MIT licence (https://github.com/Tonejs/Tone.js). Third-party notices are in `tone/Tone.js.LICENSE.txt`.
- `salamander/*.mp3`: 20 notes (C, D#, F#, A in octaves 3 to 7) of the Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm, as published in https://github.com/Tonejs/audio (`salamander/`). Licensed CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
